channel.title: GlassGrid You
channel.description: Most recent releases of GlassGrid You for macOS.

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
What's New in GlassGrid You 1.1.1

  • Unified macOS Liquid Glass Titlebar: Crisp 52pt unified titlebar alignment keeps traffic-light buttons concentrically inset inside the floating Liquid Glass sidebar with zero corner clipping across Light and Dark modes.
  • Native Fullscreen Polish: Seamless toolbar handoff on notched MacBook Pro displays ensures the sidebar header and top controls (including Multiview) stay cleanly visible below the bezel.
  • Multi-Window & Sparkle 2 Auto-Updates: Independent macOS windows (⌘N), draggable 120Hz Multiview tile dividers, Companion Web Tiles (Twitch, ESPN, NFL.com, Prime Video), Sidebar Channel Folders, and silent EdDSA-verified Sparkle updates.
